Role Type: Individual Contributor

Primary Location: Tokyo, Japan

At The Coca Cola Company, our ambition is to refresh the world and make a difference, and finance plays a critical role in bringing that vision to life. As part of our Finance Hub, the FP&A Supply Chain Corporate team ensures the integrity, transparency, and efficiency of key financial processes that enable the entire system to thrive. In this role, you will contribute to accurate product costing and pricing processes, delivering insights that support innovation and operational excellence across multiple regions. By leveraging your analytical expertise and digital fluency, you will help optimize supply chain transparency, standardize processes, and build efficiencies that support growth across emerging and established markets. If you are passionate about finance, technology, and improving global processes in a collaborative and forward-thinking organization, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact within one of the world’s most recognized brands.

What You Will Do For Us

• Prepare, release, and maintain product standard costs and related SAP master data for new product launches or reformulations for assigned plant locations, ensuring accurate and timely communication to stakeholders.
• Execute re‑costing of materials based on Bill of Material changes, analyzing cost impacts and validating results for assigned plants.
• Lead Pricing and Purchase Price Variance (PPV) processes for assigned locations, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure pricing compliance and accuracy.
• Oversee daily deliverables from third‑party service providers for pricing and accounting tasks, validating work against internal controls and corrective action standards.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for costing and pricing escalations, applying a broad perspective to resolve complex issues.
• Coordinate internal and external audit requirements relating to costing, revenue, and volume reporting, maintaining proper documentation and compliance standards.
• Promote consistent application of global standards and best practices in cost and pricing management, partnering with regional teams for continuous improvements.
• Reconcile and monitor Cost of Goods Sold clearing account balances for timely recognition of financial results.
• Drive process optimization by identifying opportunities for enhancement, preparing performance metrics, and facilitating alignment across teams.
• Act as finance subject‑matter contributor on global initiatives such as S/4HANA deployments and other supply chain transformations, ensuring finance requirements are effectively represented.

Requirements And Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; equivalent practical experience accepted.
• Minimum of 5 years’ progressive experience in finance, accounting, or supply chain costing roles.
• Professional accounting designation (CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
• Proven proficiency in SAP or similar integrated manufacturing systems.
• Strong digital and data literacy, including the ability to leverage analytics for decision support and process efficiency.
• Fluency in English; Additional languages such as Japanese is preferred.
• Ability to build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and manage external service provider performance.
• Demonstrated growth mindset with experience in driving process improvements and embracing transformation initiatives.
• Skilled in managing competing priorities, analyzing complex data, and applying problem‑solving to supply chain challenges.

What We’ll Do For You

• Enable you to work on regional and global initiatives that directly support Coca‑Cola’s supply chain and operational strategies.
• Provide exposure to digital transformation projects that shape how finance operates globally, expanding your technical capabilities.
• Offer robust development opportunities including mentorship, cross‑market collaboration, and access to the company’s learning platforms.
• Connect you with a dynamic and diverse team focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and process standardization.

Skills For Workday

• Financial Planning & Analysis
• Cost Accounting and Product Costing
• SAP and ERP System Proficiency
• Data Analysis and Insight Generation
• Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement
• Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement
• Digital Fluency and Technology Adoption
• Problem‑Solving and Root Cause Analysis
• Adaptability and Change Orientation
• Communication and Collaboration

Job Description – Lead Finance & Accounts

Youthville | Pune, Maharashtra | Full-Time | 6 Days Working

Lead – Finance & Accounts

Pune, Maharashtra

6 Days Working | Work from Office

Experience: 5+ years, including leadership experience

About Youthville

Youthville is a hospitality and managed-living venture of the Kohinoor Group, focused on providing premium, comfortable and community-driven accommodation experiences. With an expanding presence in Pune and ambitions to grow its footprint across Pune and Mumbai, Youthville is building a scalable, professionally managed accommodation business.

At Youthville, we believe that great experiences for residents begin with strong systems, operational excellence and a committed team. As we continue to grow, we are looking for experienced finance professionals who can strengthen our financial foundation, drive process excellence and contribute to the company's long-term business growth.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualified Lead – Finance & Accounts to take complete ownership of the finance and accounting function at Youthville.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a finance professional who has worked in a startup or high-growth business environment and can independently manage end-to-end finance operations, financial planning, accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, cash flow, audits and management reporting.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical accounting expertise with business acumen, leadership capabilities and the ability to build scalable financial systems in a growing organisation.

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Finance & Accounting

Take complete ownership of the finance and accounts function across the organisation.

Oversee day-to-day accounting, general ledger, journal entries, reconciliations and month-end and year-end closures.

Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, including the Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement.

Establish robust accounting policies, internal controls and standard operating procedures.

Ensure accurate accounting of revenue, expenses, vendor payments, customer collections, advances and accruals.

Monitor financial transactions across properties, departments and business entities.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Analysis

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.

Prepare monthly MIS reports, variance analysis and financial dashboards for management.

Analyse revenue, operating costs, property-level profitability and business performance.

Monitor key financial indicators, cost efficiency and profitability across locations.

Provide actionable financial insights to management for strategic and operational decisions.

Support business expansion plans through financial modelling, feasibility analysis and investment evaluation.

3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

Manage direct and indirect taxation, including income tax, GST, TDS and applicable statutory compliances.

Ensure timely filing of returns, payment of taxes and reconciliation of statutory records.

Oversee tax audits, statutory audits, internal audits and other regulatory requirements.

Coordinate with external consultants, auditors, banks and regulatory authorities.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws and corporate regulations.

Monitor compliance requirements across relevant legal entities and business operations.

4. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Manage daily cash flow, liquidity planning and working capital requirements.

Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate funds for business operations.

Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, vendor settlements and collection cycles.

Develop controls for payment approvals, expense management and fund utilisation.

Maintain banking relationships and support financing requirements wherever applicable.

5. Internal Controls & Process Automation

Develop and implement strong financial controls and approval mechanisms.

Identify opportunities to automate accounting, reporting and finance workflows.

Improve financial processes, documentation, reconciliation and audit readiness.

Implement standardised finance practices across properties and business units.

Work with cross-functional teams to ensure financial discipline and process compliance.

6. Leadership & Business Partnering

Lead, mentor and develop the finance and accounts team.

Establish clear responsibilities, performance standards and reporting timelines.

Partner with business leaders, operations, sales, procurement and management teams.

Work closely with senior management on financial strategy, risk management and business planning.

Support new property launches, expansion projects, commercial evaluations and financial due diligence.

Build a proactive finance function that supports business growth rather than merely recording transactions.

Candidate Requirements

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) qualified — mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated leadership or team-management experience.

Startup exposure: Prior experience working in a startup, scale-up or high-growth organisation is strongly preferred.

Strong expertise in end-to-end accounting, taxation, financial reporting, budgeting, MIS and cash flow management.

Experience managing audits, statutory compliances and multiple business operations or entities.

Ability to independently lead the finance function and establish processes from the ground up.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Proficiency in accounting systems, Excel and financial reporting tools; experience with ERP or cloud-based accounting platforms is an advantage.

A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

Why Join Youthville?

Be Part of a Growing Business

Join an expanding managed-accommodation venture and contribute to building the financial backbone of a growing hospitality business.

End-to-End Ownership

Lead the complete finance and accounting function, with the opportunity to shape processes, controls, reporting systems and financial strategy.

Direct Management Exposure

Work closely with senior leadership and contribute to key business decisions, expansion planning and operational improvements.
Build and Improve Systems

Create scalable financial processes and introduce automation, stronger controls and data-driven decision-making.
Entrepreneurial Work Environment

Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where initiative, accountability and practical problem-solving matter.

Compensation & Employment Details

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a finance leader who has moved beyond routine accounting and is ready to take complete ownership of a growing organisation's financial operations. Someone who understands startup realities, builds processes without excessive supervision, maintains financial discipline and translates financial data into meaningful business decisions.

If you are a qualified CA with startup experience and a passion for building scalable finance functions, we would love to hear from you.
